product_metadata.title: DOWAN Tea Mug with Infuser and Lid, 20 OZ Large Porcelain Tea Cup, Easy to Hold, Pefect for Loose Leaf Tea, Tea Bag, Coffee
features: 20 OZ Large Capacity. Tall Mug. Larger than common 14-16 oz mug, Dowan tea mug set is 20oz(600ml), big enough for individual or serving, office or home. Great tea cup for tea, tea bag, herb, coffee, water or any liquid.

Deep and Large Infuser for Full Steeping. This tea strainer is large enough for tea leaves to expand and fully brew. The holes are so tiny that your tea won’t end up with particles in it. Bring you an excellent output.
Large and Heat-insulted Handle for Easy Holding. The large and heat-insulted handle is easy to grip and never gets hot. You can also lift the tea infuser cup through the thickened mug edge.
The lid can keep the tea warm much longer and works well as a tea infuser holder. You can use the lid to rest your tea basket or tea bag on when your tea is finished steeping.

Safe and Healthy Material. The tea infuser mug is made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE and NON-TOXIC ceramic. The smooth glaze make it easy to clean in dishwasher. Microwave and Freezer Safe Also. And the tea strainer is 18/8 stainless steel. Dishwasher Safe Also.
